description: First-pass local CM1 dry-failed-cumulus reference case: heating and vertical motion without meaningful cloud liquid water.
physical_question: How can lower-atmosphere heating and thermal motion occur without enough moisture to form shallow cloud?
expected_outcome: Rising motion / thermal activity but no meaningful cloud liquid water.

cloud_scale_policy.local_runtime_cost_note: Roughly 3.4x the prior committed cell count; intended for local validation runs, not app runtime.
cloud_scale_policy.supersedes_note: The earlier 120 km / 2 km-grid output remains workflow/provisional evidence, not final cloud-scale visual validation.

namelist_input_concept.forcing_concept: Surface sensible heating with weak moisture supply over a dry external sounding.
namelist_input_concept.moisture_contrast: Lower near-surface qv and lower latent moisture flux than shallow-cumulus baseline.

sounding_profile_concept.format_reference: CM1 input_sounding format: first line surface pressure, theta, qv; following lines z, theta, qv, u, v.
sounding_profile_concept.free_atmosphere: Drying quickly with height to keep LCL high and saturation unfavorable.
sounding_profile_concept.final_level_note: Final sounding level is above ztop.

expected_output_files: cm1out_stats.nc or cm1out_stats.dat/ctl depending on CM1 output settings
required_fields: pressure or pressure-derived metadata if available
diagnostics_to_compute: max cloud liquid water near zero
integrated cloud liquid water near zero
high LCL or unfavorable saturation state
how_to_ingest: After local output exists, use the #179 CM1 reference adapter path to map selected output into reference-run-v1/reference-frame-v1 data. Do not point the frontend directly at raw CM1 output.
known_limitations: First-pass configuration may need tuning after output inspection.
Tiny transient condensate should be evaluated against an explicit meaningful-cloud threshold.
The case is a reference contrast, not universal atmospheric truth.
notes: CM1 is offline reference-model output; Cloud Lab does not run CM1 in normal app sessions.
No generated CM1 output is committed with this manifest.
